name: James Pearce
old_description: My name is James Pearce. I am a sculptural furniture artist working out of my studio in Peoria Illinois.
about:
James Pearce operates a sculptural furniture studio in Peoria, Illinois. The artist works independently from a local studio, producing one-of-a-kind and made-to-order pieces. No founding year or ownership structure is publicly disclosed beyond the sole-proprietor model implied by the studio format.

The studio creates sculptural furniture and wall-mounted works, offering both unique pieces and items available for order. Production is handled on-site, with an emphasis on custom fabrication; the site invites clients to request variations on existing designs. Scale appears limited to studio-level output, with no facility size, headcount, or volume figures published.

The business serves individual collectors, interior designers, and clients seeking custom furniture art. No specific industries or commercial customers are identified in available materials beyond the direct-to-consumer and trade channels suggested by the shop sections.

Pearce positions the studio around direct collaboration, encouraging prospective buyers to describe their vision for tailored pieces. The artist’s own statement frames the practice as responsive to client ideas rather than a fixed catalog, highlighting a willingness to adapt designs to specific requests.
